title: Ask HN: Discuss burnout with boss?
guide_zh: 自己调整一年仍然倦怠，作者想知道如何与老板开启这场谈话。
author: dummy_123
excerpt: I am burnt out at work and not sure how to start the discussion with my boss. I've tried addressing the problem myself over the past year by means of exercise, diet, getting more sleep, more time spent on hobbies, socializing more, and pacing myself at work. It's not helping, it's just getting worse. I know quitting and finding a new job is an option but I would prefer not to. How can I have a productive discussion with my boss about burnout? How did you handle it?

title: Tell HN: Unicorns aren't ad-supported
guide_zh: 观察高估值公司名单后，作者指出独角兽中主要依赖广告的公司并不多。
author: Animats
excerpt: Looking at the "Complete list of unicorns"[1], something stands out. Out of the top 50 startups by valuation, only three, Snapchat, Pintrest, and Vice, are ad-supported. The others all sell a product or service paid for by its users. Advertising may have powered the first dot-com boom, but it's not powering this one. [1] https://www.cbinsights.com/research-unicorn-companies/
